title: rewriteFrontmatterEffort insert path interpolates frontmatterBody into the repl…
description:
rewriteFrontmatterEffort insert path interpolates frontmatterBody into the replacement string passed to String.replace; a body containing $-sequences ($&, $1) would be reinterpreted. Agent frontmatter is controlled content so the risk is nil, but a replacer function would be more robust.
